narrative.overview: The original site at https://www.nextgenventures.com.au/ is the binding visual authority. This document captures the implemented replica, rather than introducing a new identity. Preserve its dark navy field, bright blue actions, generous section spacing, photographs, original poppy imagery, and moving community gallery.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy surfaces with pale typography and vivid blue actions.
Geometric headlines, compact navigation, and generous space between sections.
Original photography and poppy imagery as the recognizable visual signatures.
dos: Do preserve the reference imagery, logo, font roles, and responsive composition.
Do retain the distinction between header blue and imported source action blue.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't invent additional palettes, token scales, or component variants.
Don't replace original photographs or poppies with generated substitutes.
Don't flatten the gallery into a static grid or add decorative shadows to source actions.
